item.title: Hedges close to Craigmount and Homewood on Harp Hill are overgrowing pavement making it difficult for pedestrians, 24th August
item.description:
Hedges close to Craigmount and Homewood on Harp Hill are overgrowing pavement making it difficult for pedestrians. This is the only available pavement along this stretch of Harp Hill which is a busy road, in particular at the moment as it being used by large construction lorries servicing the Oakley Farm development. Please can the hedges be cut back to improve pedestrian safety.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Harp Hill, Battledown, Cheltenham, Cheltenham

item.title: The drain is blocked problem, 24th August
item.description:
Customer reports that water was flooding into the premises at the location over the weekend, following rain. This has affected electrics in the building and isn't safe. A contractor has been in to investigate and reports that a drain has collapsed. They request that this is addressed asap, before it rains again. Feedback/update requested at Highway's earliest convenience.
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Large, sever bumps in surface, 24th August
item.description:
There are some large, severe bumps in the road surface, on a previous repaired area, on the westbound side of the carriageway, just west of the 'raised' traffic calming area. There bumps are extremely hazardous to cyclists/motorcyclists (it is easy to lose control, or almost get thrown off), and users of small vehicles. The issue seems to have worsened this summer. Please retrun to a smooth surface.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 102, Station Road, Bishop's Cleeve, Tewkesbury
